description: MeshCore/Meshtastic node logger for the Cap LoRa-1262

store.summary: Log MeshCore and Meshtastic nodes heard over the air with the Cap LoRa-1262 radio and GPS.
store.description: MeshHunter listens (receive only) on the MeshCore and Meshtastic presets with the Cap LoRa-1262 hat, verifies and logs MeshCore adverts (repeaters, companions, rooms, sensors) with the GPS position where they were heard, decodes default-channel traffic, and writes CSV files compatible with the MeshHunter desktop app for upload to WDGWars or a self-hosted ingest API.
